messages.content: I have the Saturday address now: 4209 Lassiter Mill Road in Raleigh. Please compare the North Hills and Midtown hotels for Friday and Saturday night, November 14 and 15. We will be driving in late from Atlanta.

I found three refundable options for one room and two adults, checking out Sunday, November 16. Hyatt House Raleigh North Hills is about 6 minutes from the gathering address and totals $495.38, including taxes, with free parking. AC Hotel Raleigh North Hills is about 7 minutes away and totals $461.45 including taxes, but parking adds $20 per night, bringing it to $501.45. Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh Midtown is about 13 minutes away and totals $398.11, including taxes and free parking.
Can you break out the nightly rates and cancellation deadlines? Also, our arrival may be after midnight Friday.

Hyatt House is $219 per night for two nights, plus $57.38 in taxes, for $495.38 total. Cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. local time on Thursday, November 13. AC Hotel is $204 per night, plus $53.45 in taxes and $40 total parking, for $501.45. Its free-cancellation deadline is 11:59 p.m. on Wednesday, November 12. Hampton Inn is $176 per night, plus $46.11 in taxes, for $398.11. It can be canceled without charge until 6:00 p.m. Thursday, November 13. All three allow late arrival if the reservation is guaranteed with a card and the front desk is notified.
Is the Hyatt total definitely complete? I do not want a parking or destination fee appearing at checkout.

Yes. The Hyatt House rate includes complimentary self-parking, and this offer has no destination or resort fee. The complete room charge is $438.00, taxes are $57.38, and the stay total is $495.38. Optional incidentals are the only charges not included.
What room type is that, and is breakfast included?

It is a king studio for two adults. Breakfast is included for both guests. The room also has a sitting area and kitchenette. The quoted rate remains refundable through 6:00 p.m. Raleigh time on November 13.
The Hampton is almost a hundred dollars less. Is there any practical reason not to take it?

The Hampton is the strongest value. The tradeoff is location: it is roughly 5 miles from the gathering address rather than under 2 miles, so Saturday travel could take 13 to 20 minutes depending on traffic. Hyatt House is within the North Hills district and would also be easier for returning to the hotel between family plans. Both include breakfast and parking, and both have the same cancellation deadline.
We will not need to return to the room during the day. Check whether the Hampton can hold the room for an arrival around 12:30 or 1:00 a.m.

The Hampton front desk is staffed overnight. They can mark the reservation for arrival between 12:30 and 1:00 a.m. Saturday morning, and the room will remain guaranteed because Friday night is prepaid or secured by card. They ask that you call if arrival slips past 2:00 a.m.
Then choose the Hampton refundable rate. Before booking, confirm the exact dates and full charge once more.

The reservation will be for one room and two adults at Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh Midtown, checking in Friday, November 14 and checking out Sunday, November 16, for two nights. The room is $176.00 per night, or $352.00, plus $46.11 in taxes, for a complete lodging total of $398.11. Self-parking and breakfast are included. Cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. local time Thursday, November 13; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax.
That works. Book it and add the late-arrival note for 12:30 to 1:00 a.m.

Booked Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh Midtown for two adults, checking in Friday, November 14 and checking out Sunday, November 16. The refundable two-night total is $398.11, including $352.00 in room charges and $46.11 in taxes; parking and breakfast are included. Free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. local time Thursday, November 13. The reservation is guaranteed for late arrival, with an expected arrival note of 12:30 to 1:00 a.m. Saturday. Hotel confirmation: RHM-731946. Your driving plan remains to leave Grant Park around 5:40 p.m. Friday and depart downtown Raleigh around 3:45 p.m. Sunday after lunch.
